mapper.select: select count(1) as participant_count, sum(case when r.exam_status in ('2', '3') then 1 else 0 end) as submitted_count, ifnull(round(avg(case when r.exam_status in ('2', '3') then r.total_score end), 2), 0) as average_score, ifnull(round(sum(case when r.pass_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) / nullif(sum(case when r.exam_status in ('2', '3') then 1 else 0 end), 0) * 100, 2), 0) as pass_rate, ifnull(max(r.total_score), 0) as highest_score, sum(case when r.exam_status = '2' and r.checked_flag = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as pending_review_count from edu_exam_record r where r.exam_id = #{examId}
